max_image_width.description: Maximum width (in pixels) allowed for loaded images.

max_image_height.description: Maximum height (in pixels) allowed for loaded images.

cache_size_mb.description: Total memory cache size in MB for decoded image data.

quality.description: JPEG compression quality (0–100). Higher = better quality but larger files.

dcm_enabled.description: Enable Deep Zoom (DCM) support for tiled image streaming.

image_directories.description: List of image source directories to serve.

path.description: Absolute or relative filesystem path to the image directory.

read_only.description: If true, prevent write operations (safe for production).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for local only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

bind_port.description: TCP port for the IIPImage server (used if FastCGI socket is disabled).

use_fastcgi_socket.description: Use a FastCGI Unix socket instead of TCP (recommended for integration with nginx/Apache).

fastcgi_socket_path.description: Path to the FastCGI Unix socket (only used if use_fastcgi_socket is true).

tile_size.description: Pixel dimension of square tiles used in Deep Zoom pyramid (common values: 128, 256, 512).

max_tile_cache_size.description: Maximum number of tiles cached per image in memory.

compression_format.description: Tile compression format: 'jpeg' (fast, lossy) or 'tiff' (lossless, larger).

watermark_path.description: Optional absolute or relative path to a PNG watermark overlay image.

client_caching_enabled.description: Enable HTTP Expires headers to improve client-side caching.

client_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Duration (seconds) to cache tiles in the client browser (only used if client_caching_enabled is true).

log_file.description: Path to the server log file. If empty, defaults to /var/log/iipimage.log.

jpeg2000_threads.description: Number of threads for JPEG 2000 decoding (if enabled).

tiff_multipage_enabled.description: Enable support for multi-page TIFF files (e.g., scanned documents).

large_tiff_support.description: Enable support for TIFF files larger than 4 GB (requires BigTIFF support in libtiff).

min_level.description: Minimum pyramid level to serve (0 = full resolution).

max_level.description: Maximum pyramid level to generate (deeper = more zoom levels).

progressive_loading.description: Enable progressive tile loading for very large images (slower start but smoother UX).
